logline: 계약을 마치러 산 위 성에 든 젊은 변호사가, 자신이 손님이 아님을 하나씩 알아 간다.
destination: 성의 잠긴 대문 — 그가 손님인지 아닌지 확인하게 되는 자리
anchor: a young clerk in a dark travelling suit and high collar, neat side-parted hair, vast Carpathian stone castle
palette: candle amber against black stone, cold moon silver, deep blood red accent, dust haze

beats.beat: 젊은 변호사가 마차에서 내려 산길을 오른다.
beats.visual: a young clerk stepping down from a coach onto a mountain road at dusk, dark pine ridges above
beats.motion: the coach lurches away, wolves' shapes shift in the treeline, his coat flares

beats.beat: 거대한 성문이 아무도 없이 저절로 열린다.
beats.visual: an enormous iron-studded castle door swinging inward on its own, a small figure waiting outside
beats.motion: the huge door swings inward, dust pours from the hinge, his lamp gutters

beats.visual: a tall thin nobleman in black holding a candelabrum in a vast stone hall, young clerk in the doorway
beats.motion: candle flames lean toward the door, the tall figure bows, shadows climb the walls

beats.beat: 이튿날 아침 거울에 백작이 비치지 않는다.
beats.visual: a small shaving mirror showing only a young clerk's reflection, a tall figure standing right behind him
beats.motion: the razor stops mid-stroke, the mirror trembles, a hand enters the frame

beats.beat: 그는 성의 모든 문이 잠겨 있음을 알아챈다.
beats.visual: a young clerk pulling at heavy locked doors along a torchlit stone corridor, keyholes dark
beats.motion: each handle jerks and holds, torches gutter in sequence, dust drifts down

beats.beat: 창밖 성벽을 무언가가 거꾸로 기어 내려간다.
beats.visual: a tall figure crawling head-first down a sheer castle wall in moonlight, cloak spread like wings
beats.motion: the figure crawls downward, the cloak ripples, moonlight slides over the stone

beats.beat: 그 궤짝들이 런던으로 실려 간다면 어떻게 될까?
beats.visual: long crates being hoisted onto a cargo ship at a foggy quay, a young clerk watching from a high window
beats.motion: a crate swings on the crane rope, fog rolls across the quay, gulls scatter

beats.beat: 안개 낀 부두에 궤짝 그림자가 길게 눕는다.
beats.visual: long crate shadows stretching across an empty foggy quay at dawn, mooring ropes slack
beats.motion: fog rolls across the stone, a rope sways, the shadows lengthen

withheld: 런던 상륙 이후 벌어지는 일과 추격 끝의 마지막
